Madhya Pradesh.note: MP State NEET PG counselling 2025 (Round 1, Round 2, Mop-up). "Institutional" = MP institutional-preference seats.

West Bengal.note: WB PG Medical counselling 2024 (Rounds 1–3, stray, special stray) — 2025 full lists were not published; 2025 online stray round included.

Bihar.note: BCECEB Bihar PGMAC-2025 allotment results (Rounds 1–3 + stray vacancy). MM = management, NRI = NRI seats in private colleges.

Odisha.note: PGMCC Odisha 2025 (Round 1, Round 2, final admitted list after stray). Ranks are Odisha Common Merit Ranks (CMR), not All India ranks.

Assam.note: DME Assam state quota 2025 (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Ranks are Assam state ranks.

Maharashtra.note: State CET Cell Maharashtra NEET(PG)-CET 2025 selection lists (Rounds 1–3 + two stray rounds). Ranks are Maharashtra State Merit List (SML) numbers. College names are the short codes CET Cell uses (e.g. BJMC PUNE).

Tamil Nadu.note: TN Selection Committee, PG Medical Government Quota 2025–26, Round 1 (26.11.2025). Ranks are TN general merit ranks. Category = the allotted candidate's community.

Punjab.note: BFUHS Faridkot PG Medical 2025, Round 1 provisional allotment. Ranks are BFUHS merit numbers. Category codes as printed by BFUHS.

Karnataka.note: KEA Karnataka PG Medical 2025: non-service Round 2, final mop-up and stray round; in-service Round 2 and mop-up. Category codes as printed by KEA (GM = general merit; codes ending in H are Kalyana-Karnataka / 371(J) seats).

Himachal Pradesh.note: AMRU Mandi, HP MD/MS/DNB 2025 final seat allocation (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Ranks are AMRU state merit numbers, not All India ranks.

Jammu & Kashmir.note: J&K BOPEE NEET MD/MS/PGD 2025: Round 2 upgraded/allotted list, ASCOMS HM/NRI list, stray round and post-MBBS DNB/diploma Round 2. Ranks are J&K UT ranks. Round 2 shows only candidates who moved or got a new seat in that round, so treat closing ranks as indicative.

Puducherry.note: CENTAC Puducherry 2023–24 PG Medical, Round 1 provisional allotment only (2025 lists were not available). Use as a rough guide. Categories are CENTAC allotted codes (UGE = general, UOB = OBC, UMB = MBC, UEB = EBC, UBM = BC Muslim, USC = SC, UST = ST, AGE = management general).

Goa.note: DTE Goa PG Degree admission 2025, Goa Medical College, Round 1 merit-cum-allotment list (state quota). Later rounds not included.
